tiles.title: Form opens
tiles.description: Total pageViews (form opens) in the time range. Same population as Forms > 'Form execution spread'. [Forms]

tiles.title: Distinct forms
tiles.description: Number of different forms opened (dcount of pageViews.name). [Forms]

tiles.title: Median form duration (s)
tiles.description: Average form load duration in seconds, pageViews with duration > 0 (same logic as Forms > 'Form usage by longest average duration'). [Forms]

tiles.title: Batch tasks executed
tiles.description: Count of BatchTaskStart events (same as the total of Batch > 'Batch server #tasks execution spread' / RunningTasks). [Batch]

tiles.title: Failed batch tasks
tiles.description: Count of BatchTaskFailure events: exceptions thrown during batch scheduling/execution (Batch > Batch Errors > 'Batch exceptions'). [Batch]

tiles.title: Batch Infolog errors
tiles.description: Infolog errors raised in batch (exceptions where ExecutionMode == 'Batch'), same as Batch > Batch Errors > 'Batch Infolog Errors'. All exceptions (any mode) are in 'Errors over time by execution mode'. [Batch / Errors]

tiles.title: DMF executions
tiles.description: Completed DMF import/export executions (distinct ExecutionId on DMFExportJobEnd/DMFImportJobEnd), same as DMF > 'Import vs export count (completed)' summed. [DMF]

tiles.title: DMF errors
tiles.description: Count of DMFError events (DMF > Errors page). [DMF]

tiles.title: Slow queries (flight off)
tiles.description: Count of LongRunningQuery events. Shows 0 until Microsoft re-enables the LongRunningQuery flight (disabled by Microsoft; LCS support issue 968862). [Slow Queries]

tiles.title: Form opens over time
tiles.description: Form opens per hour (Forms > 'Form execution spread'). [Forms]

tiles.title: Batch running vs throttled tasks
tiles.description: Running tasks (BatchTaskStart) vs throttled tasks (BatchThrottled) per 10 minutes (Batch > 'Throttled batch tasks'). [Batch]

tiles.title: Errors over time by execution mode
tiles.description: All exceptions (Infolog errors) per hour split by ExecutionMode (Errors > 'Sum of errors per Execution Mode' / 'by Time Span'). [Errors]

tiles.title: Top 10 slowest forms (avg duration)
tiles.description: Top 10 forms by average duration (Forms > 'Form usage by longest average duration'). [Forms]

tiles.title: Top 10 batch errors (Infolog + task failures)
tiles.description: Most frequent batch error messages by job caption: Infolog errors (exceptions, ExecutionMode == 'Batch', outerMessage) plus BatchTaskFailure exceptions (ExceptionMessage). Message truncated to 300 chars. [Batch]

tiles.title: Top 10 DMF executions by duration
tiles.description: Longest DMF executions per entity/ExecutionId (DMF > 'Executions by duration (top 100)', limited to 10). [DMF]

tiles.title: Activity by environment
tiles.description: Side-by-side counts per F&O environment (customDimensions.environmentId) for the selected time range. Same definitions as the KPI cards. [Forms + Batch + DMF + Errors + Slow Queries]

tiles.title: Form execution by Legal Entity
tiles.description: Form opens split by legal entity (Forms > 'Form execution by Legal Entity'). [Forms]

parameters.description: F&O environment (customDimensions.environmentId), seen in the last 7 days

queries.text:
pageViews
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| summarize ['Form opens'] = count()

pageViews
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| summarize ['Distinct forms'] = dcount(name)

pageViews
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| where duration > 0
| summarize ['Median duration (s)'] = round(percentile(duration,50)/1000,2)

customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where name == "BatchTaskStart"
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| summarize ['Batch tasks'] = count()

customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where name == "BatchTaskFailure"
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| summarize ['Failed batch tasks'] = count()

exceptions
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| extend ExecutionMode = tostring(parse_json(customDimensions).ExecutionMode)
| where ExecutionMode == "Batch"
| summarize ['Batch Infolog errors'] = count()

customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where name == "DMFExportJobEnd" or name == "DMFImportJobEnd"
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| extend ExecutionId = tostring(parse_json(customDimensions).ExecutionId)
| summarize ['DMF executions'] = count_distinct(ExecutionId)

customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where name == "DMFError"
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| summarize ['DMF errors'] = count()

customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where name == "LongRunningQuery"
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| summarize ['Slow queries'] = count()

pageViews
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| summarize ['Form opens'] = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by timestamp asc

let _scale = '10m';
customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where name in ("BatchThrottled", "BatchTaskStart")
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| summarize ThrottledTasks = countif(name == "BatchThrottled"), RunningTasks = countif(name == "BatchTaskStart") by TimeSum = bin(timestamp, totimespan(_scale))
| project TimeSum, RunningTasks, ThrottledTasks
| order by TimeSum asc

exceptions
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| extend ExecutionMode = tostring(customDimensions.ExecutionMode)
| extend ExecutionMode = iff(isempty(ExecutionMode), "(not set)", ExecutionMode)
| summarize Errors = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), ExecutionMode
| order by timestamp asc

pageViews
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| where duration > 0
| project ['Form name'] = name, duration
| summarize     ['Avg duration (s)']    = round(avg(duration)/1000,2)
            ,   ['Executions']          = count()
            ,   ['Max duration (s)']    = round(max(duration)/1000,2)
            ,   ['Percentile 95 (s)']   = round(percentile(duration,95)/1000,2) by ['Form name']
| top 10 by ['Avg duration (s)'] desc

let infologErrors = exceptions
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
    | extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
    | extend ExecutionMode = tostring(cd.ExecutionMode)
    | where ExecutionMode == "Batch"
    | project timestamp, Source = "Infolog error", BatchJobId = tostring(cd.BatchJobId), BatchJobCaption = tostring(cd.BatchJobCaption), Message = outerMessage;
let taskFailures = customEvents
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where name == "BatchTaskFailure"
    | where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
    | extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
    | extend ExceptionMessage = tostring(cd.ExceptionMessage), EventMessage = tostring(cd.EventMessage)
    | project timestamp, Source = "BatchTaskFailure", BatchJobId = tostring(cd.BatchJobId), BatchJobCaption = tostring(cd.BatchJobCaption), Message = iff(isnotempty(ExceptionMessage), ExceptionMessage, EventMessage);
union infologErrors, taskFailures
| extend Message = substring(Message, 0, 300)
| summarize Occurrences = count(), ['Distinct job ids'] = dcount(BatchJobId), ['Last seen'] = max(timestamp) by ['Batch job caption'] = BatchJobCaption, Message, Source
| top 10 by Occurrences desc

customEvents
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where name in ("DMFImportJobStart","DMFImportJobEnd","DMFExportJobStart", "DMFExportJobEnd")
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend EntityName = tostring(cd.EntityName)
| extend ExecutionId = tostring(cd.ExecutionId)
| extend LegalEntity = tostring(cd.LegalEntity)
| extend TotalNumberOfRecords = tolong(cd.TotalNumberOfRecords)
| extend direction = iff(name startswith "DMFExport", "Export",
                     iff(name startswith "DMFImpot", "Import",
                     iff(ExecutionId has "Import" or ExecutionId has "import", "Import", "Export")))
| summarize Duration = max(timestamp)-min(timestamp), Start = min(timestamp), End = max(timestamp), LegalEntity = take_any(LegalEntity), Records = max(TotalNumberOfRecords), Direction = take_any(direction) by EntityName, ExecutionId
| top 10 by Duration desc

let forms = pageViews
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
    | summarize FormOpens = count(), LastSeen = max(timestamp) by EnvironmentId = tostring(customDimensions.environmentId);
let events = customEvents
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where name in ("BatchTaskStart", "BatchTaskFailure", "DMFError", "LongRunningQuery")
    | where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
    | summarize BatchTasks = countif(name == "BatchTaskStart"), FailedBatchTasks = countif(name == "BatchTaskFailure"), DMFErrors = countif(name == "DMFError"), SlowQueries = countif(name == "LongRunningQuery"), LastSeen = max(timestamp) by EnvironmentId = tostring(customDimensions.environmentId);
let dmf = customEvents
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where name == "DMFExportJobEnd" or name == "DMFImportJobEnd"
    | where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
    | summarize DMFExecutions = count_distinct(tostring(customDimensions.ExecutionId)), LastSeen = max(timestamp) by EnvironmentId = tostring(customDimensions.environmentId);
let errs = exceptions
    | where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
    | summarize Exceptions = count(), BatchInfologErrors = countif(tostring(customDimensions.ExecutionMode) == "Batch"), LastSeen = max(timestamp) by EnvironmentId = tostring(customDimensions.environmentId);
union forms, events, dmf, errs
| where isnotempty(EnvironmentId)
| summarize ['Form opens']           = sum(coalesce(FormOpens, 0))
          , ['Batch tasks']          = sum(coalesce(BatchTasks, 0))
          , ['Failed batch tasks']   = sum(coalesce(FailedBatchTasks, 0))
          , ['Batch Infolog errors'] = sum(coalesce(BatchInfologErrors, 0))
          , ['DMF executions']       = sum(coalesce(DMFExecutions, 0))
          , ['DMF errors']           = sum(coalesce(DMFErrors, 0))
          , ['Exceptions (all)']     = sum(coalesce(Exceptions, 0))
          , ['Slow queries']         = sum(coalesce(SlowQueries, 0))
          , ['Last telemetry']       = max(LastSeen) by ['Environment Id'] = EnvironmentId
| order by ['Environment Id'] asc

pageViews
| where timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isempty(_environmentId) or tostring(customDimensions.environmentId) in (_environmentId)
| extend ['Legal entity'] = toupper(tostring(customDimensions.LegalEntity))
| summarize count() by ['Legal entity']

union pageViews, customEvents, exceptions
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| extend EnvironmentId = tostring(customDimensions.environmentId)
| where isnotempty(EnvironmentId)
| distinct EnvironmentId
| order by EnvironmentId asc
